patch:
diff --git a/docs/maintainer/kernel-optimization-campaign.md b/docs/maintainer/kernel-optimization-campaign.md
index 59b8efe3..6ef7ad87 100644
--- a/docs/maintainer/kernel-optimization-campaign.md
+++ b/docs/maintainer/kernel-optimization-campaign.md
@@ -20,14 +20,25 @@ Freeze these facts before the first build:
 | Controls | candidates per cycle, acceptance threshold, and no-win terminal count |
 
 The active campaign convention is 24 candidates per cycle. The first candidate that clears every
-gate closes the cycle, becomes the accepted baseline, and starts a new cycle with a fresh profile.
-A target stops after one complete 24-candidate cycle produces no accepted candidate. The user may
-replace any of these values; record the replacement in the campaign result before continuing.
+gate closes the cycle, becomes the accepted baseline, and starts a new single-mechanism cycle with
+a fresh profile. One complete 24-candidate single-mechanism no-win cycle freezes its immutable
+ledger and starts a separate consolidation phase when the retained evidence supports at least one
+compatible multi-patch package. Consolidation has its own ledger and a maximum of 24 packages,
+uses the same correctness and real-boundary gates, and stops at its first accepted package. The
+target stops after one complete consolidation no-win cycle, or immediately when the frozen
+single-mechanism evidence yields no eligible package. The user may replace any of these values;
+record the replacement in the campaign result before continuing.
 
 The active real-boundary gate is two independent candidate repetitions, each at least 2% faster
 than the fresh cycle baseline, with exact accounting and no material regression at unaffected
-concurrency points or route seams. A hypothesis-specific public-Op gate may be stronger when the
-kernel's measured share shows that a smaller Op gain cannot produce a 2% round win.
+concurrency points or route seams. A user-controlled hybrid gate may replace this default. The
+current SM86/SM89 rerun campaigns use two independent repetitions that each satisfy either at least
+1.5% lower matched GPU round latency or at least +3.0 aggregate published tokens/s. The absolute
+arm additionally requires positive matched latency improvement, a throughput delta clearly above
+fresh-baseline noise, and identical drafted, accepted, and licensed-token accounting. Repetitions
+and concurrency points are never averaged to cross either threshold. A hypothesis-specific
+public-Op gate may be stronger when the kernel's measured share shows that a smaller Op gain cannot
+reach the active real-boundary gate.
 
 ## Worktree and build preparation
 
@@ -94,6 +105,27 @@ row with the candidate/commit, mechanism, prediction, oracle result, public-Op r
 real-boundary result, decision, and restoration commit. This keeps the accepted source clean while
 preserving why a tempting idea was rejected.
 
+## Multi-patch consolidation
+
+Consolidation begins only after a complete single-mechanism no-win cycle. Freeze that ledger by
+commit and content hash, restore and re-profile the retained baseline, then classify promising
+rows as dispatch-disjoint, overlapping, mutually exclusive, or cache/resource interacting. Rank
+only coherent packages whose conservative current-baseline ceiling can reach the active gate.
+Historical component measurements are ranking evidence; every included component must be
+re-evaluated on the current retained source.
+
+Before editing a package, record its component ledger IDs and commits, dispatch domains and files,
+interaction class, conservative ceiling, resource/cache risks, combined-effect hypothesis,
+expected affected/neutral matrix, and disproof observation. Mutually exclusive mechanisms may not
+share a package, overlapping savings are discounted rather than added, and unrelated ideas are not
+bundled merely because their historical percentages sum above the threshold.
+
+A consolidation package is one candidate and one source commit. Rebuild and remeasure every
+affected public Op, then advance only plausible packages to the same two real-round repetitions,
+full C/seam matrix, independent oracles, registered real test, and short/long Engine sentinels.
+Rejected packages receive normal restoration commits in the separate consolidation ledger. The
+original single-mechanism ledger remains immutable.
+
 ## Cycle closure and evidence
 
 After an accepted candidate:
@@ -105,8 +137,10 @@ After an accepted candidate:
 
 After a complete no-win cycle, restore the accepted source through normal reverts, verify the final
 source matches the cycle-start source, rebuild/retest the accepted binary, commit the result and
-concise rejection ledger, and apply the terminal rule. Then freeze a new target-specific baseline
-for the next model in the declared sequence.
+concise rejection ledger, and enter the consolidation phase when an eligible package exists. Stop
+the target only when its consolidation terminal rule fires or the frozen evidence supports no
+eligible package. Then freeze a new target-specific baseline for the next model in the declared
+sequence.
 
 Commit accepted source, retained tests/benchmarks, the campaign controls, summarized results, and
 concise ledgers. Large `.nsys-rep`/Nsight Compute reports, SQLite exports, full model logs, and build
diff --git a/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm89-rerun-campaign.md b/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm89-rerun-campaign.md
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..2816ed37
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm89-rerun-campaign.md
@@ -0,0 +1,68 @@
+# SM89 Muse and Qwen rerun campaign
+
+Date: 2026-08-21. This campaign reruns Muse Glimmer first and Qwen3.8-27B second on the WSL host
+`DESKTOP-DG588BU`, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, compute capability 8.9, driver 596.21, CUDA 13.3.73,
+and a Release `sm_89` image. It uses only the isolated worktree
+`/ai/ginfer/.worktrees/agentic-kernels-sm89-rerun`, branch
+`perf/agentic-kernels-sm89-rerun`, seeded at the exact accepted commit
+`ec7c79679d466b0a427bd44d1a85ed78db729c73`. The primary checkout and the existing SM89 worktree
+remain read-only.
+
+## Frozen controls
+
+- Target order: Muse Glimmer DFlash2, then Qwen3.8-27B MTP3.
+- Candidate policy: one mechanism per ordinary candidate, maximum 24 candidates per cycle, and
+  first accepted candidate closes and restarts from a fresh baseline/profile.
+- Real-boundary gate: two independent matched repetitions must each achieve either at least 1.5%
+  lower GPU round latency or at least +3.0 aggregate published tokens/s at the declared primary
+  concurrency. The absolute arm also requires positive matched latency, a delta above fresh
+  baseline noise, and identical drafted, accepted, and licensed-token accounting. Repetitions and
+  concurrency points are not averaged to cross the gate.
+- Correctness/neutrality: independent public-Op oracle, affected matrix and dispatch seams,
+  unaffected concurrency controls, complete C=1..8 review, registered real-artifact test, and
+  short/long public Engine semantic sentinels. Production prefill and Engine runs use
+  `CUDA_MODULE_LOADING=EAGER`.
+- Terminal rule: one complete 24-candidate single-mechanism no-win cycle freezes its ledger, then
+  starts a separate maximum-24-package consolidation phase when compatible evidence-supported
+  packages exist. The target stops after a complete consolidation no-win cycle, or immediately
+  when no package has a plausible current-baseline path to the same gate.
+- Evidence: durable summaries and ledgers are committed; bulk profiler reports and logs remain
+  under ignored `profiles/sm89/rtx4090/` paths.
+
+## Muse Glimmer cycle 1
+
+Artifact: `/mnt/nas/AltaStratusAI/models/Muse-Glimmer-30B-NInfer/muse_glimmer_30b.ninfer`,
+18,047,450,368 bytes, registered identity `muse-glimmer-30b/groupwise-int-dflash-q4`. The frozen
+route is DFlash2 draft width 4, INT8-G64 Main KV, context 8,192 tokens/request, fixed context and KV
+capacity 131,072, stochastic sampling defaults with seed 42, and primary concurrency C8. The target
+Program round is the real performance boundary; short/long public Engine retrieval fixtures are
+semantic sentinels rather than paired throughput evidence.
+
+The exact start binary passed the Q4/W8 Linear, Q4/W8 LinearSwiGLU, Muse GQA, general GQA, grouped
+dynamic convolution, and registered Muse real-artifact tests. Fresh Program baseline:
+
+| C | GPU round mean (ms) | Published tok/s | Drafted | Accepted |
+|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
+| 1 | 36.4502 | 115.683 | 124 | 100 |
+| 2 | 39.8506 | 211.668 | 248 | 200 |
+| 3 | 45.8895 | 275.811 | 372 | 300 |
+| 4 | 41.2831 | 409.019 | 496 | 400 |
+| 5 | 74.3472 | 284.070 | 620 | 500 |
+| 6 | 75.7058 | 334.544 | 744 | 600 |
+| 7 | 66.2900 | 445.829 | 868 | 700 |
+| 8 | 53.5001 | 630.912 | 992 | 800 |
+
+An independent C8 repeat measured 53.5411 ms and 630.457 tok/s with the same 992 drafted and 800
+accepted tokens. The fresh measured-only Nsight Systems round reported 53.5746 ms. Its dominant
+device work was the SM89 R32C40/BK128 Q4 route at 27.728 ms (43.1%), the SM89 R64C40/BK128 Q4 route
+at 22.147 ms (34.4%), W8 at 4.015 ms (6.2%), and Muse GQA partial/reduce at 5.205 ms (8.1%). Raw
+evidence is retained under
+`profiles/sm89/rtx4090/muse-rerun-cycle1/baseline-ec7c7967/`.
+
+The first fresh candidate will re-evaluate a prior SM89 near-win against this current binary and
+hybrid real-round gate; historical measurements are not accepted as current evidence.
+
+## Qwen3.8-27B
+
+Pending Muse consolidation terminal. Its artifact, workload, baseline, profile, and ledger will be
+frozen only after the Muse handoff.

+## Muse Glimmer cycle 3
+
+Cycle 3 accepted Candidate 4, commit `1d0bac78`, by freshly re-evaluating a documented historical
